channel_conventions.deck_rows: PDF lists each deck row once for ch 1/2/3/4 (status 9n/Bn, n = deck - 1). Deck 1 rows keep the plain name on ch 1; decks 2-4 have their own rows named <name>_deck2/3/4 on ch 2/3/4.
channel_conventions.channel_assignment: ch1 browser (shared with deck 1), ch1-4 decks 1-4, ch5 effect+mixer, ch12 MIDI-OUT illumination
channel_conventions.sides: Left deck side sends deck 1 or 3 and the right side deck 2 or 4, by DECK SELECT (fig 1-11).
